revision_budget: Initial P1344 binding; one post-R1 contract revision remains available only for a newly measured contract failure class.

composition.rule: Load the exact protected P1343 FINAL R2 contract and binding and the exact P1344 capsule-baseline overlay. Preserve every inherited capsule table record, hook call record, grammar category, carrier field/API rule, facade rule, P1342 composition and forbidden binding except the exact syntax override for P1343-FUNC-CARRIER-HELPERS. Append the two exact P1344 records. Missing, extra, duplicated, reordered or mismatched files, rows, capsules, categories or hashes are Violated.
composition.hook_rows: The exact nineteen P1342 row records and row_capsule_bindings composed by P1343 FINAL R2 are preserved without field, type, role, condition, order, source/runtime or cardinality change. Only helper declaration ownership for H10/H11 and carrier forwarding used by H12A/H12B changes.

grammar_composition.inherited: The complete P1343 FINAL R2 grammar_categories object, capsule_syntax_table records except P1343-FUNC-CARRIER-HELPERS, hook_call_contract, carrier_ledger_skeleton, facade_ab_contract and authority rules are normative at their protected binding hash.
grammar_composition.owner_associated_methods: The complete capsule body is a nonempty finite sequence of associated function items directly inside the already-open inherent impl named by the syntax record. Every method has exactly one outer #[cfg(EXACT_CFG)], crate-private visibility no broader than pub(crate), the exact name/signature/receiver/effects in method_set and effect_rule, and consumes all tokens once. No impl item, owner close/reopen, nested/nonlocal impl, module, const/static/type item, block/wrapper/container, macro, trait, use/import/reexport, alias, public product item, extra attribute, extra method or method of another entity is grammatical.
grammar_composition.physical_owner: The source verifier resolves the enclosing inherent impl from lexical tokens and the exact protected anchors. Candidate-declared owner names, imports, aliases and marker comments are untrusted. The entire body must remain after the owner opening brace and before its measured associated item/closing boundary.
grammar_composition.marker_and_normalization: Use the exact P1344 overlay marker policy and inverse normalization: all 38 exact IDs once, 12 allowlisted files, no unknown/nested/overlapping markers, descending live byte-offset replacement, and exact recovery of all twelve candidate-free whole-file hashes.

capsule_syntax_overrides.owner: the existing impl Func between the protected namespace and closing-brace anchors
capsule_syntax_overrides.syntax_form: finite cfg-only associated Func method sequence inside existing impl Func
capsule_syntax_overrides.effect_rule: Install, read, clone/forward and append only through the exact closed P1343 carrier API. No Content or CounterUpdate method or impl, no raw state access and no alternate writer.

capsule_syntax_overrides.owner: the first existing impl Content containing elem_name, immediately before elem_name
capsule_syntax_overrides.syntax_form: one cfg-only associated Content method inside existing impl Content
capsule_syntax_overrides.effect_rule: Match only the real Content::CounterUpdate variant and project H11 read-only through its existing action/carrier. No field, variant, constructor, writer, mutation, lookup by equality/name/output/address or reconstructed Location.

capsule_syntax_overrides.owner: the unique existing impl CounterUpdate immediately before step
capsule_syntax_overrides.syntax_form: one cfg-only associated CounterUpdate method inside existing impl CounterUpdate
capsule_syntax_overrides.effect_rule: Match only CounterUpdate::Func and borrow or clone the same existing Func carrier for H10 and subsequent H12A/H12B forwarding; Set and Step return absence. No callback execution, carrier construction, writer, mutation or alternate lookup.

owner_helper_binding.separation: The five sets are exact and disjoint by owner. No method may move to another owner, be aliased/reexported, be supplied through a trait/extension or be duplicated outside its designated capsule.

hook_call_contract.rule: The exact twelve direct-hook records, receivers, methods and argument rules in P1343 FINAL R2 are preserved without change. Their hooks are H00D,H00S,H01,H02,H03,H05,H11,H12A,H12B,H13,H14,H16; the remaining seven rows are bound through the exact composed replacement/helper semantics.

carrier_ledger_skeleton.preservation: The exact P1343 FINAL R2 carrier_ledger_skeleton is preserved: one closed enum with the nineteen hooks; closed raw event and append receipt types; one private ledger state with challenge/frozen/events/receipts; one cloneable opaque Arc carrier; one immutable raw snapshot; one read-only projection; and exactly new, append, snapshot and project storage operations.
carrier_ledger_skeleton.single_writer: P1343Carrier::append remains the sole raw writer and sole Vec::push site. It enforces not-frozen and computes the exact P1342 event and receipt formulas. No new P1344 capsule may declare storage, construct raw events/receipts post hoc, expose mutable state or append outside that API.
carrier_ledger_skeleton.split_effect: Only method declaration ownership is split. Func forwards the same carrier, CounterUpdate::Func exposes that same carrier for H10/H12 and Content::CounterUpdate reads it for H11. There is no second carrier, ledger, cell, snapshot, projection, writer or side table.

facade_ab_contract.facade: The exact P1343 single-run test-only facade production is preserved. It accepts verifier-created World, Source, 32-byte challenge and closed mode, delegates exactly once, obtains exact H16 raw snapshot and projects read-only; it creates/clones/selects none of those inputs and fabricates no evidence.
facade_ab_contract.ab_test: A new independent P1344 Rust test, frozen after seal and before candidate access, constructs three real fresh World/Source/FileId/challenge sets, calls the facade once per normal/repeat/reverse mode and validates exact P1342 row, carrier, Location, snapshot, identity and cardinality obligations. Historical P1342/P1343 tests do not satisfy this gate.

source_runtime_boundary.source: Source proof is limited to exact pins/schemas, lexical markers, anchors, inverse normalization, closed capsule AST grammar, exact owner and adjacency, the carrier skeleton shape and twelve candidate-free hashes. It cannot prove semantic reachability, def-use, runtime freshness, callback count or cardinality.
source_runtime_boundary.runtime: Only an independently compiled and challenged P1344 Rust receipt from real candidate facade output proves reachability, freshness, identities, raw causality, cardinalities and read-only projection.
source_runtime_boundary.synthetic: Synthetic source/runtime is oracle-corpus-only and cannot cross into candidate or final evidence.

authority_root_contract.strict_json: Every JSON input rejects duplicate decoded keys at every depth and non-finite numbers, then validates exact closed keys/types/order/cardinality before any value is trusted.
authoring_order: 1. Emit canonical P1344 corpus first and compute its SHA-256.
2. Emit source verifier and checker with immutable exact P1344 pins and literal EXPECTED_CORPUS_SHA256; no CLI override.
3. Record corpus/checker/source-verifier hashes in the authorship receipt and hand them out of band to adversary and preseal authority.
4. The verifier treats the handed-off checker whole-file hash as trust root, rehashes before load and rejects all corpus bytes unlike EXPECTED_CORPUS_SHA256.
authority_root_contract.authority_root_formula: authority_root_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785([step_sha256, authority_manifest_sha256, contract_r1_sha256, binding_r1_sha256, capsule_baseline_sha256, l0_freeze_sha256, fixture_sha256, source_verifier_sha256, expected_corpus_sha256, checker_sha256])).
authority_root_contract.fail_closed: A self-consistent alternate corpus/checker/root, candidate-authored path/hash pair, sibling digest, duplicate-key object, changed order/budget/case set, missing compiled pin or root mismatch is Violated before any case executes.

classification.preserved: Only a valid inspectable case passing every applicable protected, structural, source and runtime predicate is Preserved.
classification.violated: Any prior failure, unsupported/ambiguous production, wrong owner, missing runtime, synthetic candidate evidence or authority drift is Violated with its first deterministic reason.
classification.unknown: Unknown remains permitted only for the single deliberately opaque P1342 dict-witness payload after every non-payload predicate passes. Parser limitations, owner ambiguity, missing evidence and exhausted budget are Violated.

forbidden_bindings: Any P1343 binding forbidden form remains forbidden at the exact protected hash.
Nested or nonlocal impl; owner closing/reopening; wrapper; const/macro container; trait/extension; import/reexport or alias used to evade physical ownership.
Content or CounterUpdate helper inside func.rs, Func helper in either new owner, a method in the wrong entity, or a fourth helper capsule.
Regex/substring/blacklist accepted as a closed grammar or source text accepted as runtime proof.
A second carrier/ledger/writer/projection, global/static side table, mutable raw escape, alternate constructor or reconstructed identity/Location.
Synthetic runtime for candidate/final, reused World/Source/FileId/challenge/ledger/snapshot identity, formatted/fabricated receipts or candidate self-attestation.
Attacker-consistent alternate corpus/hash/checker/root, duplicate-key last-wins parsing, CLI digest override or protected input drift.
A thirteenth consumer, any public/default/phase/compatibility change or weakening of the nineteen P1342 rows.
